description: This file defines the EnterpriseCallbackControls class with static methods to manage and check the status of callbacks, including whether they are disabled dynamically via headers or request parameters, and whether the user has permission to disable callbacks.

classes.name: EnterpriseCallbackControls
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to determine if callbacks are disabled dynamically based on headers, request parameters, and user permissions.

methods.name: is_callback_disabled_dynamically
methods.description: Checks if a specific callback is disabled via headers or dynamic parameters, considering user permissions.

methods.name: get_disabled_callbacks
methods.description: Retrieves a list of disabled callbacks from request headers or request body parameters.

methods.name: _should_allow_dynamic_callback_disabling
methods.description: Determines if dynamic callback disabling is permitted based on admin settings and user premium status.
